approval_note: User approved parallel v1.1/v1.2 execution planning; v1.1 remains unchanged.
purpose: Pooled held-out comparison when per-project v1.1 quotas are infeasible, with project-stratified inference.

change_of_estimand.v1_1: Every project must independently satisfy protected/unprotected/unknown/legal quotas.
change_of_estimand.v1_2: The pooled candidate universe satisfies the class quotas; project is the inference cluster and receives equal weight.
change_of_estimand.not_a_silent_relaxation: This is a pre-registered protocol amendment with a different estimand. v1.1 and v1.2 results must never share denominators.

project_eligibility.independence: independent repositories or explicitly separated project families; no historical project used to fill quotas
project_eligibility.environment_blocked_rule: A project with a blocked deployment or baseline gate is reported as blocked and is not silently removed from a winning denominator.

pooled_candidate_quota.source: A read-only checker recomputes counts from frozen per-project candidate pools; values may not be hand-entered.

class_support.unsupported_class_rule: If a class occurs in fewer than two projects, report it as descriptive_only and exclude it from superiority criteria.

methods.Ours-full-pre: Frozen project-specific intake plus generic SE/DP/JE, with zero live knowledge reads.
methods.Ours-generic: Empty project-specific contract plus generic SE/DP/JE; never label this Ours-full.
methods.ChaosEater-adapter: Separate adapter implementation; never merge with official CE.

comparison_lines.equal_information: All methods receive the same frozen candidate metadata; no experiment history is exposed.
comparison_lines.realistic_end_to_end: Each method uses its declared pipeline and knowledge tier; evidence and selection outcomes remain separate.
comparison_lines.v1_1_parallel_rule: A v1.1 run may proceed only under v1.1 per-project eligibility; it cannot be relabeled as v1.2.

statistics.paired_difference: For each project, compare the method score with the CE-official score; aggregate project differences with clustered bootstrap or permutation.
statistics.minimum_project_claim: A single project is descriptive only.

superiority_criteria.weakness_floor: Ours-full-pre Weakness@K must not be lower than CE-official.
superiority_criteria.evidence_endpoint: At least one pre-registered non-descriptive evidence endpoint must favor Ours-full-pre.
superiority_criteria.ci: The project-level paired difference CI for the claimed endpoint must not cross zero.
superiority_criteria.ce_blocked: CE environment_blocked is not a win and remains non-comparable for that project.
superiority_criteria.claim_scope: Any positive claim is limited to the v1.2 pooled project-stratified protocol.

gates: P0: approve this amendment and freeze its JSON/MD pair
P1: recompute pooled feasibility from frozen pools
P2: generate and freeze a v1.2 candidate registry without result-derived filtering
P3: freeze method IDs, runner, seeds, blindness, cleanup and analysis
P4: pilot bring-up and baseline gates
P5: formal execution only for eligible, comparable projects
forbidden: lowering any pooled quota after seeing results
using historical execution results to filter or pad a pool
counting load generators or test tools as business kill targets
calling connection timeout a request timeout
calling retry/circuit without bounded timeout protected
selective removal of CE-blocked candidates to claim superiority
